200.description: Scan applied; the journey after the scan.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value true, only when the response is a replay of the answer stored for the Idempotency-Key.

etaStart.description: Start of the day-of ETA window (ADR 0013). Present, with etaEnd, only while the state is OUT_FOR_DELIVERY and the window is not older than the last applied scan; omitted otherwise. The window is shown as received and is never clipped to the promised delivery window.

etaEnd.description: End of the day-of ETA window. Present exactly when etaStart is.

destinationKind.description: Present only on a pickup journey (ADR 0016).

pickupPointId.description: The point of a pickup journey (ADR 0016).

readyForCollectionAt.description: When the package reached its point (ADR 0016).

holdUntil.description: The retention deadline of an uncollected package (ADR 0016).

scanType.description: Kind of observation (ADR 0002 A5). Each type has fixed edges: SHIPMENT_CONFIRMED (LABELLED stays), PICKUP_DEPARTURE (LABELLED to HANDED_OVER), DEPARTURE (HANDED_OVER or IN_TRANSIT to IN_TRANSIT), TRANSIT_ARRIVAL (HANDED_OVER or IN_TRANSIT to IN_TRANSIT), STATION_ARRIVAL (HANDED_OVER or IN_TRANSIT to AT_STATION), CARRIER_HANDOFF (AT_STATION to WITH_CARRIER, ADR 0015), OUT_FOR_DELIVERY (AT_STATION or WITH_CARRIER to OUT_FOR_DELIVERY), DELIVERED (OUT_FOR_DELIVERY to DELIVERED), DELIVERY_FAILED (OUT_FOR_DELIVERY to AT_STATION, or to WITH_CARRIER for a journey with a carrier choice: the carrier re-attempts from its own custody).
scanType.title: ScanType

applied.description: False for a scan stored out of order or without an edge from the state it met.

400.description: idempotency-key-required (the Idempotency-Key header is missing) or idempotency-key-invalid (not 1-128 printable ASCII characters).

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

404.description: not-found. The addressed label or journey does not exist.

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

409.description: duplicate-scan (ErrDuplicateScan), scan-out-of-order (ErrScanOutOfOrder, stored not applied), journey-closed (ErrJourneyClosed), illegal-transition (stored not applied), concurrent-update or idempotency-key-reused (the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request).

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

422.description: validation-failed. The request is well-formed JSON but violates a value rule.

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.

500.description: internal-error. An unmapped failure; the detail never carries the cause. Never cached by the idempotency middleware, so the same key retries the work.

type.description: Problem type slug, for example label-already-issued.
